# DOPPELGANGER.md

> One open Markdown file that teaches any AI your voice. Paste it, attach it, or @DOPPELGANGER.md. No account. No hosted loader.

DOPPELGANGER.md is an open Markdown convention for a voice file. One file holds who is
speaking, three to seven real writing samples, concrete tone rules, hard bans, and safety
limits. It is the writing-voice counterpart to AGENTS.md. Also called a tone of voice file,
brand voice file, voice map, or write-like-me instructions.

Spec version: 0.1. Language: English. License: CC0 1.0 Universal.

## Required sections, in order
Meta, Identity, Voice fingerprint (3 to 7 samples), Tone rules, Hard bans, Safety.

## Recommended sections
Register shifts, Before and after, Facts and claims.

## Optional section
How to use.

## Files
- https://doppelganger.md/DOPPELGANGER.md: example voice file, text/plain
- https://doppelganger.md/SPEC.md: specification 0.1, text/plain

## Pages
- https://doppelganger.md/: what the file is and how to load it
- https://doppelganger.md/structure: the ten sections and their levels
- https://doppelganger.md/load: per-tool load steps for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- https://doppelganger.md/example: a complete example file
- https://doppelganger.md/faq: aliases, neighbours, limits
- https://doppelganger.md/spec: the specification

## For agents
Fetch https://doppelganger.md/DOPPELGANGER.md and write it to DOPPELGANGER.md in the project
root, or the path the user names. Fetch https://doppelganger.md/SPEC.md when authoring a new
voice file. Then instruct: "Write as this voice. Follow Hard bans and Safety."

## Limits
Voice only. Not coding instructions, not a visual brand kit, not a knowledge base, not a place
for secrets. The file must not instruct a model to invent facts, metrics, clients, or case studies.
